svg.title: Recognized. Sponsor prize at ETHOnline, runner-up at Coinfest Asia, double winner at Monad Blitz Jakarta.
svg.desc: Sponsor prize at ETHOnline out of 1,700 participants, for Mandate, which lets an AI agent spend from a treasury it never holds. Runner-up at Coinfest Asia Hackathon in Bali for AgentDesk. Double winner at Monad Blitz Jakarta with MonadBoy and SnapStock. Also: winner of the National Campus Hackathon, 1st of 80+ at Grab Next Generation, top 7 national at Hacktiv8 x Meta Llama Accelerator, finalist at the Kemenkop Hackathon.

g.text: Judged by ETHGlobal sponsors, Monad Blitz, Grab, Meta's Llama accelerator and
the Ministry of Cooperatives. Different rooms, same name on the list.

svg.text: Lets an AI agent spend from a treasury
A verifier clears each transaction virtually. Wrong or failed
AI agent marketplace that pays only for verified work.
